newsitem.title: USA: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.
newsitem.headline: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls.

text.p: CME cattle and pork complex pre-opening calls as of 0805 CDT.
LIVE CATTLE - Steady to off 0.150 cent. Fed cattle sold down to $63 Tuesday and boxed beef prices slipping.
FEEDER CATTLE - Up 0.100 to off 0.100 cent. Index up to new high for the move and corn futures seen easier.
LEAN HOGS - Steady to off 0.100 cent. Cash hogs seen mostly steady to weak after rain in the Midwest.
PORK BELLIES - Off 0.200 to up 0.100 cent. Firm product, neutral out-of-town and reports of product moving from storage supportive, but market anticipates hog report Friday.
